purpose: Qualify a known degree-conditioned informative Person-Rater assignment generator against an exact small-state oracle before any product UI or estimator-performance claims.

mechanism.distribution: Pr(G | fixed Person degrees, fixed Rater degrees, connected direct Rater overlap) proportional to exp(gamma * T(G))
mechanism.statistic: T(G) is the sum over assigned edges of standardized known Person ability times standardized known Rater severity

claim_boundary: Passing qualifies this finite-state generator and its row materializer, not MFRM estimators under informative assignment.
No FACETS output is consumed because this phase tests the assignment layer before responses exist.
A downstream frozen response-generation study must separately compare FACETS 4.5 JMLE, Python JMLE, MML, and exact CMLE on generated outcomes.
FACETS displayed two-decimal fit values must never be used as raw inputs or treated as unrounded fit parity evidence.
